model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the retrieval ratios of various large language models (LLMs), with the model names listed on the horizontal axis in a specific order and the retrieval ratio percentage on the vertical axis, ranging from 0 to 50 in increments of 10. The vertical axis is labeled "Retrieval Ratio (%)". The bars represent the retrieval ratio for each model, with colors varying across models, including shades of gray, green, blue, purple, brown, light blue, and pink. The retrieval ratios range from approximately 25.92% for Claude 3 Opus to 46.94% for DeepSeek-V3. Specifically, the bars show the following retrieval ratios: Expert at 34.11%, GPT-4o at 29.07%, GPT-4o-turbo at 29.16%, GPT-4o-mini at 43.57%, Claude 3 Opus at 25.92%, Claude 3.5 Sonnet at 31.56%, Claude 3.5 Haiku at 28.49%, Gemini 1.5 Pro at 39.37%, Llama 3.1-405B at 37.99%, Mistral Large at 31.04%, DeepSeek-V3 at 46.94%, Owen-Max at 34.84%, and GLM-4-Plus at 43.58%. The bars are not sorted in a specific order, such as ascending or descending retrieval ratio, and are instead arranged according to the order of the model names on the horizontal axis, with no bars being visually emphasized.
